source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.3.2 (PDF 133, printed 130).

blocks.text: Data jama hone ke baad use analysis ke liye tayyar karna zaroori hai. Is mein data ko saaf karna (ghaltiyan aur be-rabti hatana), use ba-maani tarteeb dena aur analysis ke qabil format mein badalna shamil hai. Jahan data ghayab (missing) ya ghalat ho, wahan researchers interpolation (aas paas ki qeematon se beech ki qeemat ka andaza) ya statistical adjustments jaise tareeqe istemal kar sakte hain ta ke data durust rahe.

Misal: Agar survey ke jawabon mein kuch maloomat adhoori ho to ghayab qeematon ka andaza dastiyab data se lagaya ja sakta hai. Sahi tayyari se analysis ke nataij qabil-e-aitbaar (reliable) aur durust (valid) hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Data ki tayyari ke teen kaam bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Ghaltiyan aur be-rabti saaf karna, data ko ba-maani tarteeb dena, aur use analysis ke qabil format mein badalna (ghayab qeematein sambhalna samait).

items: Tayyari: saaf karna, tarteeb dena, format badalna; ghayab data sambhalna.
